result.instructions: Tools for Lime CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contacts were created in Lime CRM this week?"; "Find the open deals of the customer Acme and list their owners."; "Create a new contact named Jane Doe at the customer Acme.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lime CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run limecrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run limecrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run limecrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. limecrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: limecrm_list_limetypes
tools.title: List limetypes
tools.description: List the limetypes (object types) of this Lime CRM application with their properties. Call this first to learn the names for the other tools. Lime API: GET /api/v1/limetype/.

tools.name: limecrm_get_limetype
tools.title: Get a limetype
tools.description: Get the definition of one limetype (its name and properties). Lime API: GET /api/v1/limetype/{limetype}/.

limetype.description: Limetype name, for example the object type name from limecrm_list_limetypes.

tools.name: limecrm_get_limeobject
tools.title: Get an object
tools.description: Get one object of a limetype by id, with its field values. Lime API: GET /api/v1/limeobject/{limetype}/{id}/.

limetype.description: Limetype name, for example the object type name from limecrm_list_limetypes.

id.description: Object id, as returned by a query or get call.

tools.name: limecrm_query_limeobjects
tools.title: Query objects
tools.description: Find objects of one limetype, returning the listed fields, with an optional filter on one property and paging. Lime Query API: GET /api/v1/query/?q=<json>.

limetype.description: Limetype name, for example the object type name from limecrm_list_limetypes.

fields.description: Property (field) names to return, for example ["name", "email"].

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default 50, max 500).

offset.description: Number of objects to skip, for paging.

tools.name: limecrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of this Lime CRM application, optionally only active ones or one user type. Lime API: GET /api/v1/admin/users/. Your API user needs admin rights to read users.

user_type.description: Only users of this type, for example "user" or "api".

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default 50, max 500).

tools.name: limecrm_create_limeobject
tools.title: Create an object
tools.description: Create one object of a limetype with the field values you pass. This writes to the customer's CRM and this server has no tool to delete or undo it. Lime API: POST /api/v1/limeobject/{limetype}/.

limetype.description: Limetype name, for example the object type name from limecrm_list_limetypes.

fields.description: Field values as an object, keyed by property name.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Lime CRM
prompts.description: What you can do with Lime CRM here, with example requests to try.
